ruleDefinitions.name: New Kernel Driver Via SC.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects creation of a new service (kernel driver) with the type "kernel"

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\sc\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*create.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*config.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*binPath.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*type.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*kernel.*")))
